confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer anchors follow Numbeo’s May 2026 Guadalajara averages. Cocktail and wine prices are estimates based on the local beer price and typical bar pricing. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from the supplied Mexican comparables.
comparable_city_reasoning: Guadalajara is a large inland regional capital, so I place its accommodation near Querétaro’s inland-city prices, somewhat above its three-star anchor for business and urban demand and below resort-city levels.
